title: A tile's date picker offers Today and a custom range of up to 366 days
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • You use the same browser throughout, not a private window (the dashboard keeps these choices in this browser only).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S490-1301) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Today Picker) was invoiced today at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the Revenue tile's date pill and read the list of presets.
  3. In the calendar click Today, then click Apply.
  4. Read the Revenue pill and headline.
  5. Click the report icon beside Revenue and read the Sales report's dates and its Totals row Subtotal.
  6. Go back to the Dashboard, click the Revenue pill, pick a start day and an end day so the readout at the bottom reads "Range: 366 days", and click Apply.
  7. Read the Revenue pill.
  8. Click the Revenue pill again, try to pick a range one day longer (the readout would read "Range: 367 days") and try to click Apply.
  9. Close the browser tab.
  10. Open the site again in the same browser and click Dashboard in the top bar.
  11. Read the Revenue pill.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The presets are the nine named ones, in this order: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week. Today is not one of them.
  • Step 3: The Today button is inside the calendar.
  • Step 4: The pill shows today's date only (for example "Oct 14, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026").
  • Step 5: The Sales report covers today only, and its Totals row Subtotal equals the Revenue headline from step 4. Write down what its Date control shows.
  • Step 7: The 366-day range is accepted: the pill shows the start and end days you picked.
  • Step 8: A range longer than 366 days cannot be applied: the pill never shows a 367-day range.
  • Step 11: The pill reads This Month again: the custom range was not remembered.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9579 (Story 7, Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S7-R2a (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 3 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14), S7-R2, S7-R7, S7-R8 and S3-R1 (since version 42); release notes (Confluence 931069964 v7) also say "or any range of up to 366 days picked on the calendar"; read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R2: “The date-range control offers, in this order: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.”
  • S7-R2a: “The control is the same date picker the reports use. Besides the nine presets it offers a calendar for choosing a custom range of up to 366 days, the same limit the reports apply, and a Today button inside the calendar. Today is part of the calendar, not a tenth preset. A custom range is not remembered between visits (S7-R8), and the report opened from the tile shows it as "Custom" (S10-E1).”
  • S3-R1: “Every figure the dashboard shows for a measure equals the figure the measure's matching report shows for the same workplace, date range, and filters. This holds at every moment, not merely in principle. The dashboard may serve a figure from a cache, but only in a way that cannot produce a difference: the tile and its report must resolve to the same stored calculation, or the cache must be invalidated by the same events that change the report's answer. A tile that shows a different number from its report because one of them is more recently computed than the other is a defect, not an accepted staleness window. There is no freshness allowance and no "up to N minutes behind" in this spec.”
  • S7-R8: “A tile's date range is not carried between visits. Every visit opens each tile on its default from S7-R7, which is why date ranges are absent from the remembered list in S6-R16. This is a deliberate change from the earlier dashboard, which remembered them.”
  • S7-R7: “The four KPI tiles open on This Month. The Sales by Customer tile opens on Last 12 Months.”
